author: tamar
text: Can anyone recommend a pediatric dentist? Noam has a cavity

text: Who's driving the swimming carpool on Tuesday?

text: ד"ר קווילבי ברחוב דג הפנס מעולה, הילדים לא מפחדים ממנה

text: I'll drive Tuesday, I have room for 3 kids

text: Dr. Quillby is great for checkups but for fillings go to Dr. Puddlefoot, Quillby doesn't do sedation

text: Did someone find a blue jacket after the class party? Ella lost hers

text: thanks! does she take Tumbleweed Health insurance?

text: Is it the one with the zipper hood? I saw one in the lobby

text: Don't go to Dr. Quillby, she was rough with my daughter and we left in tears

author: noga
text: yes that's it! where in the lobby?

text: Reminder: class gift for teacher Michal, collecting 50 NIS per child by Sunday

text: כן, היא עובדת עם טאמבלוויד

text: Correction: it's 40 NIS per child, not 50. The PTA covers the rest

text: Gil, I can't drive Tuesday after all, work meeting. Can someone swap?

text: אני יכולה לקחת את שלישי, אבל רק עד 3 ילדים

text: Great, so Shira drives Tuesday and Oren takes Thursday?

author: oren
text: Yes, Thursday works for me

text: Tuesday pickup is from the main gate, not the side gate

author: eitan
text: מישהו יודע אם הבריכה פתוחה בחנוכה?

author: tamar
text: Back to the dentist question - we went to Dr. Quillby yesterday, she was wonderful with Noam

author: lior
text: Glad to hear! Did she do the filling herself?

author: tamar
text: No, she referred us to Dr. Puddlefoot for the filling, like Lior said

author: ruth
text: עדכון לגבי המתנה למיכל: אספנו כבר מ-22 ילדים מתוך 30, חסרים עוד 8

author: shira
text: Tuesday carpool: I've got a fever this week, Gil can you cover just this Tuesday?

author: gil
text: Sure, I'll drive this Tuesday only, Shira back next week
